rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/audit/rules.d" install -m 0640 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/rules/10-base-config.rules" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/audit/rules.d/audit.rules"
# No systemd, and no actions for the old service command of SysV init. FULL_PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" rm -rf "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/systemd" "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/tmpfiles.d" rm -rf "$FULL_PREFIX/libexec/initscripts"
# The completions for bash where Debian has them. if [ -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/bash_completion.d/audit.bash_completion" ]; then install -d -m 0755 "$FULL_PREFIX/share/bash-completion/completions" mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/bash_completion.d/audit.bash_completion" \ "$FULL_PREFIX/share/bash-completion/completions/audit" rmdir "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/bash_completion.d" fi
